theme_strategy: Dark Canonical ('Part 5' System). Forced dark mode for maximum focus, long-session comfort, and high-trust data density. No light mode toggle for the demo environment.

typography.primary_font_usage: Used for all standard UI elements, calm/human summaries, headings, and navigation.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Used strictly for 'verbatim' documentary evidence, timestamps, legal clauses, IDs, and raw data extraction points.

colors.css_variables_setup: Define these in index.css under :root or .dark

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) tailored for SaaS Admin/Legal Data. Every pixel must be utilized. No jagged bottoms.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none or max 4px (rounded-sm) for a sharp, authoritative, brutalist legal feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Flat Solid surfaces. No glassmorphism. Legal data needs optical clarity without visual refraction.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px subtle borders (border-[#27272a]) to separate data sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to zero shadows. Rely on background color stepping (--paper -> --card -> --document) and 1px borders for elevation.

Demo.jsx.purpose: Dashboard Overview for the synthetic workspace.

sections.name: Synthetic Workspace Banner
sections.layout: Fixed or prominently pinned at the top. Full width.
sections.styling: bg-[#18181b] border-b border-[var(--stamp)] text-[var(--stamp)] font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest p-2 text-center
sections.content: Sandbox / Demo Environment - Synthetic Data Only

sections.name: What Matters (Ranked Section)
sections.content: Ranked alerts: imminent renewals, risky clauses. Use --stamp for critical risks, --pending for upcoming renewals.

sections.name: All Contracts List
sections.layout: Dense data table or list view (col-span-full).
sections.styling: Headers in Archivo labels, data rows mapping to IDs in IBM Plex Mono. Hover state on rows: hover:bg-[#18181b] transition-colors.

DemoContractDetail.jsx.purpose: Split-view contract analysis page proving the 'Calm vs Verbatim' design principle.

sections.name: Left Panel: Calm Summary
sections.content: Human-readable summary using Archivo. Clear hierarchy. Action buttons using --seal color.

sections.name: Right Panel: Verbatim Evidence
sections.content: Raw extracted contract text. Highlighting matching clauses using background colors (e.g., bg-[var(--seal)]/20 text-[var(--seal)]).

sections.name: Navigation
sections.styling: Absolute or sticky top left inside the Calm Summary panel.
sections.content: Back button to /demo. Simple icon + text, e.g., '< Back to Dashboard'

image_urls.description: User profile avatar for the demo workspace header
Secondary user avatar or counterparty contact
Subtle dark texture for empty states or authentication screens if needed

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Ensure --ink-soft (zinc-400) against --paper (zinc-950) meets 4.5:1.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for row hovers and panel transitions.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through background color stepping (--paper to --card to --document), not heavy shadows.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead. Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use solid background for headers; DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
instructions_to_main_agent: Focus exclusively on building Demo.jsx and DemoContractDetail.jsx using the specific 'Part 5' dark canonical design system. Implement the custom CSS variables in the root CSS file. Use pure raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and standard Shadcn components purely for interactive elements (tables, dropdowns). Ensure strict visual separation between the Archivo-based 'Calm Summary' and the IBM Plex Mono-based 'Verbatim Evidence' in the contract detail split view. Ensure all files are .jsx (not .tsx) as requested by the environment.
